pxtiertagger.config.gamemode.none:
§cFetching gamemodes failed, selected tierlist may be down.§r
Pxokie's TierTagger will still work, but you can try restarting your game.
pxtiertagger.config.highest.desc:
- Never: only display tiers in the selected gamemode
- When Not Found: if a person isn't ranked in the current selected gamemode, show their highest tier overall
- Always: display a person's highest tier, regardless of the gamemode
pxtiertagger.config.position.desc:
- Auto: above the name on Lunar Client, next to the name everywhere else
- Next to Name: in front of the name (like TierTagger)
- Above Name: as its own line above the nametag (works on every client)
pxtiertagger.keybind.nearest: Show all tiers of nearest player
